entries.text: I’m sure Kofu is real sad about forgetting his\nwallet here...
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_01

entries.text: Please take it to him in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Porto Marinada[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], on the\nother side of the desert! I’m counting on you!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_02

entries.text: [EMPTY 67]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_receptionist_03

entries.text: What? YOU again?!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01a

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! Where?! Where in the world...?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_26

entries.text: Where in the world is my wallet?![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_27

entries.text: Without my wallet, I won’t be able to get today’s\nhot item! It’ll get bought up by someone else![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_28

entries.text: *sniffle*[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_29

entries.text: Don’t worry, ol’ man Kofu! I’ll run and look for it\nright now!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_01b

entries.text: Whaddya want? Ol’ man Kofu’s in the middle of\nsome superduper important ingredient buyin’!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_02

entries.text: If yer thinkin’ about tryin’ to interrupt him, then\nI—his best apprentice—will have to stop you!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_03

entries.text: So do ya have somethin’ super important to\nsay to us busy folks, or what?
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_04

entries.text: This is super important!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_a

entries.text: Uh, I guess it’s not that important...
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_b

entries.text: Don’t bother us with somethin’ unimportant! Run\nback on home now, y’hear!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_05

entries.text: Super important, eh? We’ll see about that!\nMaybe a battle will shut yer mouth!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_06

entries.text: Dangit! That backfired... And now my wallet’s\nempty, too!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_07

entries.text: Heya, step right up...and tell me—what’s all the\nruckus about over here?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_01

entries.text: O-ol’ man Kofu! Seems this kid’s got somethin’\nto say to ya.
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_trainer_08

entries.text: What’s that, now? A customer here for little ol’\nwalletless, moneyless me? What kin I do for ya?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_02

entries.text: I have your wallet!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_01

entries.text: You forgot this!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_02

entries.text: You returned Kofu’s wallet to him!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_01

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza! My wallet![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_03

entries.text: Say what, now? My lobby staffer sent ya out here\nto bring it to me?[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_04

entries.text: Gahaha! That’s a huge help! Thanks for comin’\nall this way![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_05

entries.text: I guess I should apologize for my li’l apprentice,\ntoo. Hope he didn’t bother ya too much![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_06

entries.text: There’s somethin’ here at the Porto Marinada\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]auction[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] that we really wanna get our hands on.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_07

entries.text: So, as you kin imagine, we were both a bit\nworked up to find I’d forgotten my wallet![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_08

entries.text: Ladies and gents! You won’t wanna miss this!\nHere comes today’s last item!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_01

entries.text: Feast yer eyes on the main event! I have ’ere the\nlegendary wakame seaweed of the Hoenn region!\r\nDo I have any takers?
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_shop_02

entries.text: Vaultin’ Veluza![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_10

entries.text: I don’ even have to touch it—I can see it’s got the\nspringy texture of seaweed chock-full o’ nutrients![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_11

entries.text: An’ just look at it! Look how it catches the light\nand shines so brilliantly![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_12

entries.text: Ohhh, and that rich, fresh aroma of somethin’\nplucked straight outta the ocean![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_13

entries.text: I need to get me some o’ that![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_14

entries.text: Now listen, kid. If you wanna challenge me at the\nCascarrafa Gym, you’re gonna need some smarts.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_15

entries.text: And this is the perfect place to test ya! Get the\nwinnin’ bid on that seaweed for this ol’ man![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_16

entries.text: What’s a “winning bid”?
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_03

entries.text: OK! I’ll give it my best shot!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_select_04

entries.text:
Well, ya see...here at the auction, you gotta
compete with other customers for goods!\c
You gotta be aware of how much money ya have,
o’ course, but the person who bids the highest
price gets to buy whatever’s on sale![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_17

entries.text: Gahaha! You already know the ins an’ outs of\nauctions at such a young age?\c\nYou’re somethin’ else, kid![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_18

entries.text: Here ya are. Fightin’ funds for the auction! Be\nsmart with it, an’ win this ol’ man that seaweed![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_19

entries.text: All right, let’s get started!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_01

entries.text: Hoenn’s legendary wakame seaweed! We’ll start\nthe biddin’ at [VAR 0x0205(0001,002C)]!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The current price is [VAR 0x0205(0002,002C)]. What will\nyou bid?
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_system_01

entries.text: Don’t bid yet
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_select_03

entries.text: Aaand we have [VAR 0x0205(0005,002C)]! We’re at [VAR 0x0205(0005,002C)]!\nDo I hear more?
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_03a

entries.text: I hear a bid for [VAR 0x0205(0005,002C)]! Do I hear more?\nWe’re currently at [VAR 0x0205(0005,002C)]!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_03b

entries.text: Sold! Sold for [VAR 0x0205(0001,002C)] to the little gentleman\nover there!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_04a

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sold! Sold for [VAR 0x0205(0001,002C)] to the little lady\nover there!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_seri_04b

entries.text: That was amazin’! You put those grown-up\nbidders to shame with yer biddin’ skills![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_20

entries.text: Thank ya for winnin’ that seaweed for this ol’\nman. I’ll be takin’ it now, if ya don’t mind.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_21

entries.text: You handed the legendary wakame seaweed\nto Kofu!
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_system_02

entries.text: This seaweed’s a great catch! I’d be feelin’ low\nas the seabed if I’d failed to get my hands on it![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_22

entries.text:
If there’s any o’ that money I gave ya left, feel
free to keep it as a tip!\c
You kin even use it to try yer hand at the auction
again if ya like![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_23

entries.text: All righty. I’mma head on back to the Cascarrafa\nGym now.[VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_24

entries.text: Ol’ man Kofu’s gonna prepare a REEL good\nbattle fer ya! See ya there![VAR 0x0114(0018)]
entries.label: gym_mizu_020_mizu_25
